seed_rule: SeedSequence([seed_root, case_index, budget_index, replica, stream]).generate_state(1, uint64), stream=0 measurement, 1 paired bootstrap

primary_test.rule: one-sided exact binomial lower-tail test, Bonferroni per cell; failure to reject is not a calibration certificate

failure_policy: All declared outer replicas count in denominators. Any failed bootstrap draw invalidates that arm's entire bootstrap interval. Point solve failure invalidates both arms. Correction failure invalidates only refitted_cv. A failed delta interval does not invalidate a solved point or its bootstrap. Unexpected execution errors abort with completed rows preserved; never selectively rerun failed rows.
limitations: Ideal QWC shots on two reused three-direction molecular banks; not full CISD banks, not physical ground-energy intervals, not hardware. Only 32 inner draws: spread interval uses central 16th/84th quantiles, not percentile tails. 64 outer replicas per cell provide limited power. No adaptive stopping or promotion/advantage claim.
